highlights.title: Wide screens open things beside Brain
highlights.line: From 1920 wide, a card or a row opens next to the chat, with your Work board beside it.

fixes: Codex keeps working after Magpie is turned off, and with models a Provider adds later.
Uninstalling Mewla gives Codex and Claude Code back their own settings.
On an ultrawide the Work board fills the screen, and from 2560 wide the chat reads larger.
